note: Free starter packs shipped as package data. Educational examples: ordinary valid DSL packs, read-only. No profit or return claims; nothing here is market-performance evidence.

examples.label: Dual moving-average crossover
examples.description: Educational example. Enters long when a 10-bar SMA of close crosses above a 30-bar SMA and exits on the cross back below, with a 5% stop. Trend-following shape; no profit or return claim.

examples.label: Mean reversion band
examples.description: Educational example. Enters long when close is under a 20-bar SMA while the 20-bar standard deviation is above 0.75, and exits when close is back at or above the mean. Mean-reversion shape; no profit or return claim.

examples.label: Range breakout
examples.description: Educational example. Enters long when close pushes above the 20-bar average high while volume is above 150, and exits on a close back below the 20-bar average low or fading volume; 14-bar ATR stop at 2.5x. Breakout shape; no profit or return claim.
